Your home becomes the collateral

Card and personal-loan debt is unsecured. Once it is rolled into a home equity loan or line, falling behind can lead to foreclosure. Interest on home equity debt used to pay off other debts is generally not tax-deductible (IRS Publication 936), and the savings disappear if the paid-off cards are run up again.
